获得节能施法时，召唤2个奥术裂片。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Frost
Gaining Brain Freeze conjures 2 Frost Splinters.

 Arcane
Gaining Clearcasting conjures 2 Arcane Splinters.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 在战斗中，冰霜会在你周围凝结，每6.0秒生成一枚冰刺。当你生成5枚冰刺后，你的下一个 [霜火之箭 / 寒冰箭]将升级为冰川尖刺。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: While in combat, Frost crystallizes around you, generating an Icicle every 6.0 sec. Upon generating 5 Icicles, [Frostfire Bolt / Frostbolt] upgrades to Glacial Spike for its next cast.

subSpellsCn.name: 冰川尖刺
subSpellsCn.description:
召唤一根巨型寒冰尖刺穿刺你的目标，造成([1300% of Spell Power])点伤害，并使其移动速度降低50%，持续8秒。

施加3层冻结效果。

subSpellsEn.name: Glacial Spike
subSpellsEn.description:
Conjures a massive spike of ice that impales your target, dealing (1300% of Spell Power) damage and slowing the target's movement speed by 50% for 8 sec.

Applies 3 stacks of Freezing.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 冰枪术会额外粉碎1层冻结。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Ice Lance Shatters 1 additional stack of Freezing.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 碎裂的爆击伤害提高，相当于你爆击几率的50%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Shatter's critical strike damage is increased by 50% of your critical strike chance.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 冰霜射线在其引导期间生成2层寒冰指。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Ray of Frost generates 2 stacks of Fingers of Frost over its duration.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 法术伤害提高3%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Spell damage increased by 3%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
冰霜射线在持续期间召唤4只寒冰之手。

冰霜射线额外获得一层充能，并且伤害提高25%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Ray of Frost summons 4 Hands of Frost over its duration.

Ray of Frost gains an additional charge and its damage is increased by 25%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
你粉碎的每一层冰冻效果都会使召唤寒冰之手的几率额外提高1.0%。

寒冰之手造成的伤害会使你的法术伤害提高0.5%，持续8秒。该效果可多次叠加。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Each stack of Freezing you Shatter increases your chance to summon a Hand of Frost by an additional 1.0%.

Damage from Hand of Frost increases your spell damage by 0.5% for 8 sec. Multiple applications may overlap.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 粉碎敌人有10%的几率召唤寒冰之手追击你的目标，造成([500% of Spell Power])点冰霜伤害，并在接触时附加1层冻结效果。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Shattering an enemy has a 10% chance to summon a Hand of Frost to pursue your target, dealing (500% of Spell Power) Frost damage and applying 1 stack of Freezing on contact.
